symptom: A CASE stored each outcome flow's OriginConnectionIndex by WHEN order only (1st 0/top, 2nd 1/right, 3rd 2/bottom; 4+ grouped thirds). `@anchor(A: (from: right))` was refused with MDL092, `@anchor(from: right)` on the CASE and `true:`/`false:` were accepted and silently ignored, and describe never emitted a CASE's outcome sides, so a Studio Pro-drawn CASE lost them on describe -> exec.
cause: parseAnchorAnnotation knew only from/to/true/false/iterator/tail keys and annotationParamName could not spell `(empty)` or a keyword value; addEnumSplit consumed the CASE's annotations without reading any anchor and never set nextFlowAnchor; emitSplitAnchorAnnotation only looked for true/false flows and mergeExitAnchor returned "" for a non-Boolean split
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLSettings.g4 (annotationParamName), mdl/visitor/visitor_microflow_statements.go (parseAnchorAnnotation), mdl/ast/ast_microflow.go (CaseAnchors), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go (splitCaseSlot.applyCaseAnchor, addEnumSplit), validate_microflow.go (checkCaseAnchors), cmd_microflows_show_helpers.go (enumCaseAnchorFragments, mergeExitAnchor)
insight: Do NOT make the default follow geometry for up to three cases, tempting as the data is (Studio Pro: straight below -> bottom 467/467, level right -> right 269/286): describe reads the WHEN order back from those sides (splitCaseOrder), and TestEnumSplitRoundtripPreservesEmptyCaseBeforeNamedCases fails the moment a branch placed out of order changes side. The per-outcome form is the escape hatch, and describe writes an entry only where the stored side differs from what the builder computes for that branch (same slot.apply, same position in describe order), so an ordinary CASE stays annotation-free. `to:` goes in the CASE entry only for a flow into a merge; into an activity it is that activity's own @anchor(to:). A bare `name: (…)` on an IF now parses as an outcome key and is refused by validation instead of the visitor. Over --mcp the create path sends no connection sides for ANY flow, so Studio Pro shows its right->left default there; verify sides on the modelsdk engine.
